schemaBase: the chrome.json schema of the reference build R (see docs/PORT-NOTES.md): every field there keeps its meaning here, as read by its consumers src/lib/templates.mjs, src/lib/seo.mjs, src/lib/home.mjs and src/build.mjs; fields R does not have are listed in `extensions`.
note:
Site chrome for the Riverside Family Eye Care rebuild, copied by tmp/wf1/facts/extract-chrome.mjs out of the raw header, top bar, menus and footer of audit/raw/index.html and the sidebar of audit/raw/contact-lenses-disposable-contacts.html (2026-10-01 crawl). Every visible string is the source's own except the entries in `authored`; tools/write-facts.mjs re-verifies each value against every chrome-bearing raw page (142 with the header and footer; 132 with the sidebar, 131 of them with the location widget, which the location post's own page prints in
instead) and exits non-zero on any difference. Links are own-origin paths (the source prints most as absolute https://www.riversidefamilyeyecare.com/... URLs); the build makes them page-relative. A "\n" inside an hours value is the source's
: that day has two ranges. `changes` lists every departure from the source markup; its ids are proposals for the design ledger.
mapQuery: Riverside Family Eye Care, 11841 Palm Beach Blvd, Unit 117, Fort Myers, FL 33905

address.label: Located at the intersection of Palm Beach Blvd and 31, in the Verandah Publix Plaza

location.title: Riverside Family Eye Care
location.emailNote: (Do not send personal health information by email.)

nap.name: Riverside Family Eye Care
nap.text: Riverside Family Eye Care - Located at 11841 Palm Beach Blvd, Unit 117, Fort Myers, FL 33905. Phone: 239-500-2020. https://www.riversidefamilyeyecare.com

authored.why: non-visible aria-label for the logo link; the source link has none (its img alt names it). R precedent: COMPONENTS.md H.2. Riverside decision pending.
fallback link text if the keyless map does not resolve. R precedent: BUILD-DECISIONS #10. Riverside decision pending.
composed from the verified NAP parts (brandName, address.*): the keyless maps?q= endpoint cannot resolve the source's place_id (R's PORT-NOTES F4).

changes.what: top-bar call button: tel: 239-500-2020 (space after "tel:") -> tel:239-500-2020, the form the mobile header, sidebar and footer NAP already use (R ledger L17)

not carried into the chrome (R ledger L11 class; the design ledger must confirm): footer voice search ("Speak Field"), sidebar search widget, "Powered by" + EyeCarePro logo (the "© 2026" stays), the Login link (https://riversidefamilyeyecare.ecpbuilder.com/wp-admin), "Return to top of menu" focus traps, the GTM noscript iframe

extensions: nav[].children: the source menu has sub-menus (3 of 6 top items); every item carries children ([] when none). R's templates render only the top level.
fax, email, sidebar.location.faxLabel / emailLabel / emailNote: the sidebar location widget prints Fax and Email (R's printed neither).

sidebar.insurance = null: Riverside's sidebar has no insurance text widget; R's aside() reads sidebar.insurance.paras and must skip a null. sidebar.social: the sidebar prints the same four icons as footer.social.
logo.srcPatternMobile: the mobile header uses a different logo file (and alt) from the desktop header.
mobileHeader.appointment.newTab (source target="_blank"); mobileHeader.menu = "nav": the hamburger prints the same tree as nav.
mapPlaceId: the source map embeds Google place_id (keyed embed/v1); kept as evidence, not used by the keyless embed.
quickActions[].sourceIcon: the source data-icon behind the mapped icon name.
footer.columns[0].title = null: the source footer menu has no heading, and there is one column (R has two; its footer() reads columns[1]).

footer.nap.postalEnd / phoneEnd / site / text: the source NAP line ends the ZIP and the phone with "." and adds the site URL; text is the whole line as printed, the oracle write-facts compares against.
footer.button: the footer prints a Request Appointment button.
footer.social: four networks (facebook, yelp, google, youtube); R's footer() draws every icon with the facebook glyph.
notice = null: the form notice is a build decision Riverside has not made (R: BUILD-DECISIONS #4).
